deadline.value: Applications for fall 2027 are due 11:59 p.m. on December 1, 2026, with no late applications.
deadline.quote: The deadline for applications for the fall 2027 academic year is 11:59 p.m. on Dec. 1, 2026

gre_general.value: NUIN does not require GRE General or Subject scores.
gre_general.quote: NUIN does not require GRE general or subject score submissions.

gre_subject.value: NUIN does not require GRE General or Subject scores.
gre_subject.quote: NUIN does not require GRE general or subject score submissions.

fee_waiver.value: NUIN cannot offer application fee waivers to international applicants at this time.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, NUIN is not able to offer application fee waivers to international applicants at this time.

english_waiver.value: NUIN waives the English test for degrees from institutions where English is the language of instruction, so an English-medium Indian degree qualifies on that basis.
english_waiver.quote: NUIN cannot waive this requirement except for applicants with undergraduate or graduate degrees from institutions in the United States or institutions where English is the language of instruction.

supervisor.value: The page asks for a supervisor's letter if possible, but does not state a rule for admission.

funding.value: All students are guaranteed a stipend, tuition and health insurance while in good academic standing in the program.
funding.quote: All students are guaranteed stipend, tuition and Northwestern student health insurance (if they opt-in) as long as they remain in good academic standing within the NUIN program.

entry_route.value: The page does not state whether a master's is needed.

notes: The NUIN application fee is $95 (see the university record). The NUIN page says the program cannot offer fee waivers to international applicants.
